label: Total operating income
note: The two income lines of the provider income statements added up. The consolidated statement prints the total.

label: Operating expenses
note: The one expense line of the provider income statements. Impairments and transfers are inside it, as in the consolidated column after them.

label: Total assets
note: The consolidated statement prints total non-current and total current assets, not a grand total, so I add the two. On the provider side I add the lines of both blocks, never their subtotals.

label: Total liabilities
note: As for assets: the printed current and non-current totals added, against the provider lines of both blocks. Liabilities are negative, as in the published statements.

label: Cash and cash equivalents
note: The balance sheet line, not the cash flow statement figure (which is net of overdrafts).

label: Total assets employed
note: Assets plus liabilities. The printed total is also a check that the four printed totals above add up.
